data.title: KSrelief Distributes 1,150 Food Baskets to Most Vulnerable Families in Yemen's Shabwa
data.content:
Shabwa, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 1,150 food baskets on Friday to the most vulnerable families in Asilan District, Shabwa Governorate, Yemen, benefiting 8,050 individuals as part of an emergency response project.
    The assistance is part of Saudi Arabia's ongoing humanitarian and relief efforts, carried out through KSrelief to support the Yemeni people and alleviate their suffering.
    -- SPA
